description: This Dart source file defines the AppState class, which manages global application state such as authentication tokens, initialization status, and persistence using shared_preferences. It provides methods to initialize, set, and clear the token, and notifies listeners about state changes.

classes.name: AppState
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier subclass managing application-wide authentication and state persistence.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the AppState by loading persisted auth token and sets the initialised flag.

methods.name: setToken
methods.description: Sets and persists the authentication token, updating state and notifying listeners.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears the authentication token from state and storage, and notifies listeners.
